translations.web: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
translations.bsb: “Skin for skin!” Satan replied. “A man will give up all he owns in exchange for his life.
translations.kjv: And Satan answered the LORD, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
translations.asv: And Satan answered Jehovah, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
